title: Dooku’s Makeshift Escape
front_description: Through the rear side of their gunship, Obi-Wan and Anakin spot a Geonosian speeder racing past. Piloting the vehicle is the unmistakable figure of Count Dooku. "Follow him!" shouts Anakin, but Padmé is wary of the risk. "We're going to need some help," she reminds her Jedi friends. "There is no time," Obi-Wan concludes, weighing the pros and cons of their mission. "Anakin and I can handle this."
back_description: Christopher Lee films his speeder scenes in front of a blue screen.
